title: cuArms: GPU-Accelerated Conflict-Based Planning for Multi-Arm Manipulation
description:
arXiv:2610.36250v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-arm manipulation has the potential to dramatically improve the throughput, efficiency, and dexterity of many manipulation tasks. Recent work coordinates multiple robot arms in a shared workcell by allocating and scheduling tasks for greater parallelism, jointly planning multi-arm motions, or directly learning multi-arm policies.
